message.content: {"version":"1","chosen":[{"id":"o2","why":"The tonal grey column anchors the formal smart look with three frost layers and a defined waist, turning the neutral palette into an elegant statement piece without needing shoes in the final count."},{"id":"o9","why":"The double-breasted suit elevates the silhouette while the trench coat provides necessary warmth; changing the scarf to carry color solves the register mismatch for the New Year party."}],"outfits":[{"id":"o2","caption":"Tonal grey column with warm scarf","pole":"tonal_column","items":["#207·03","#481·01","#369·32","#539·37","#156·38"],"day":"This unified achromatic column looks polished and formal for the upscale restaurant, with the tonal coat providing three necessary layers against the frost; the milk-colored scarf breaks the monotony near the face to match her eye color windows."},{"id":"o9","caption":"Grey check suit with camel trench","pole":"anchor_first","items":["#458·11","#347·32","#530·11","#539·37"],"day":"The double-breasted grey wool suit defines the silhouette for the celebration, paired with a fitted maxi trench in graphite wool to handle the frost; the beige check scarf adds texture and warmth while keeping the register classic."}],"needed":[{"kind":"shoes","description":"Knee-high boots needed to complete the bottom slots and continue the leg line under both outfits.","type":"boots","color":"brown","fabric":"leather"}]}
